appName: Race Master VR: Stunt Car Racing
displayName: Race Master VR: Stunt Car Racing
display_name: Race Master VR: Stunt Car Racing
display_long_description:
Race Master VR: Stunt Car Racing puts you in full control of high-performance cars in a fast-paced virtual reality racing experience designed exclusively for Meta Quest. Step into the cockpit, feel the speed, and take on extreme stunt tracks that push your driving skills to the limit.

Race across challenging courses filled with steep ramps, massive jumps, tight corners, and precision-based driving sections. Every turn, drift, and landing is built to deliver an immersive and comfortable VR experience while maintaining intense racing excitement.

🚗 Immersive VR Driving

Enjoy a first-person cockpit view with responsive steering and smooth acceleration. The controls are optimized for VR, making every race feel natural, engaging, and exciting.

🏎️ Extreme Stunt Racing

Test your skills on stunt-focused tracks featuring high jumps, narrow paths, and high-speed sections that demand focus and control.

🎯 Skill-Based Gameplay

Master drifting, braking, and speed management to complete tracks efficiently and improve your performance with each race.

🌐 Optimized for Meta Quest

Built for smooth performance and comfort on Meta Quest headsets, allowing longer play sessions with stable visuals and immersive gameplay.

Whether you love VR racing games, stunt driving challenges, or realistic driving simulators, Race Master VR delivers intense action and thrilling moments behind the wheel.

Start your engines and prove you have what it takes to become the ultimate Race Master in VR.
